name: readable proof-carrying manifest to opaque Git-blob identity binding

authoritative_readable_manifest.authority_scope: own role-local repository state only; this is not a claim that arbitrary external unsigned manifests are trustworthy

rules: Require the readable manifest path itself to have the expected/current admitted REPO_IDENTITY when such identity is part of the checkpoint.
Parse only precommitted fields payload_path and payload_blob_sha from the small JSON manifest.
Require payload_path to be a simple relative basename with no slash, backslash, dot-dot or empty value in this bounded checker.
Resolve payload_path relative to the manifest directory.
Read only the resolved repository path's Git blob SHA; binary bytes are not a semantic input.
PASS iff resolved path exists and current blob SHA exactly equals manifest.payload_blob_sha.
A missing path, unsafe relative path or mismatched SHA rejects.
binding_checker.complexity: One manifest text read/parse plus one repository identity read and one digest equality for a single payload; bounded checker, not a general JSON/path parser claim.

result.transversal_value: A readable role-local manifest can carry the expected identity of an otherwise opaque binary artifact. Scheduled Chat can validate the manifest-to-current-artifact relationship using only text fields plus Git blob identity, avoiding both rebuild and byte-faithful binary readback for identity-level reuse decisions.
result.what_is_now_certified: The current resolved payload path is exactly the Git object identity named by the current admitted manifest.
what_is_not_certified: The binary bytes' semantic meaning or executable behavior.
That an arbitrary external manifest is authentic; authority must be established separately.
That the artifact was freshly built from source.

next_frontier: Extend manifest to multiple payload entries and declared environment/config inputs, with a finite completeness rule that rejects unknown/unbound fields influencing the decision.
Test stale manifest/current-payload mismatch using a new role-local probe while keeping r145 capsule immutable.
Investigate authenticated external manifest status surfaces; raw signature bytes alone are not accepted without an exposed zero-quota verification result.
